summary: Backend-only retest of the 4 iteration-6 minor fixes on the MongoDB reconciliation endpoints. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_migrate.py (23 pytest cases, 23/23 PASSED, ~30s) against the public preview URL. Verified: (1) GET /api/_diag/db is now protected — no token -> 403 with no mongo_host/db_name/collections leakage in the body, garbage bearer -> 401/403, client1 -> 403, superviseur -> 200 with the same fields as before (mongo_scheme=mongodb+srv, sanitised mongo_host, db_name=albarka, 18 collection counts, no credential fragments). (2) POST /api/_admin/migrate-mongo dry_run=true without only_collections no longer reports 'otps' nor 'cron_runs' (ephemeral skip) while still covering 'users'. (3) only_collections=['otps'] DOES include otps (skip applies only when only_collections is empty) — report has exactly one key 'otps'. (4) Real run backup=true only_collections=['users'] wrote /tmp/albarka-migrate-backups/mongo-<stamp>/users.json outside the repo; every document has password_hash='[REDACTED]' and no '$2a$'/'$2b$' string exists in the file; /app/backend/backups no longer exists (old dumps removed). Non-regression of all 17 previous cases: inventory RBAC (no token/bad token 401-403, client 403, superviseur 200 without password_hash/_id), POST guards (no token 403, client 403, wrong confirm_token 400, target==source 400, missing fields 422, unreachable target 502), dry_run writes nothing (verified via pymongo on albarka_dryrun), only_collections / skip_collections filters, real migration of report_templates idempotent (run1 inserted=1, run2 inserted=0/skipped=1, no duplicate ids), protected_partial>=1 with sentinel password_hash + is_active=false preserved on admin@sawalismartsystems.com and non-protected fields synced. Also re-ran the full backend suite: 229 passed / 1 skipped. Production DB 'albarka' never written to.

minor.issue: MIGRATE_CONFIRM_TOKEN is not defined in /app/backend/.env, so the hardcoded fallback 'MIGRATE-EMERGENT-TO-ATLAS-2026' in albarka_migrate.py is what is actually enforced. The env-read fix works but is inert until the variable is set (and the fallback remains in source).

Known accepted tech debt (unchanged): synchronous run vs 30s ingress timeout, to_list(100_000) unbounded cursor, target_mongo_url taken from the request body (SSRF-shaped), no index creation on the target DB, no cleanup/retention for /tmp/albarka-migrate-backups (2 dirs currently on disk).
